stem: Which sentence does the author use to suggest that the caterpillar has experienced an important change?

options.label: F
options.text: Up and down the caterpillar's head moved, weaving and weaving.

options.label: G
options.text: At last the veil grew so thick that you could only guess that the caterpillar might still be at work inside.

options.label: H
options.text: But the caterpillar did not die.

options.label: J
options.text: Many days and nights passed, and at last what had once been the caterpillar began to stir and wake.
